camel_example: aliyun maxcompute GET /api/v1/projects/autoCluster/info --region cn-hangzhou --sinceCreated true --pageNumber 1 --sortField savedCu --pageSize 10 --order true --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Performs a paged query on the tables that have automatic clustering benefit records for the current tenant in the current region, and retrieves the number of benefited jobs, saved compute resources, and shuffle data volume for each table through paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前租户在当前地域有自动聚簇收益记录的表，查看各表的受益作业数、节省的计算量和 Shuffle 数据量
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute list-auto-cluster-info --since-created true --sort-field savedCu --order true --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2022-01-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAutoClusterInfo

parameters.help_en: The benefit statistics range. A value of false indicates that the daily benefits from the latest batch of data are retrieved. A value of true indicates that the cumulative benefits after clustering is applied are calculated. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 收益统计范围。false 表示取最新一批数据中的当日收益，true 表示累计统计聚簇应用后的收益。默认为 false
parameters.name: since_created

parameters.help_en: The sort field. Valid values: `savedTime`, `savedCu`, `savedShuffle`, `benefitJobCount`, and `date`. Default value: `savedCu`
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。支持 `savedTime`、`savedCu`、`savedShuffle`、`benefitJobCount`、`date`。默认使用 `savedCu`
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. A value of true specifies ascending order. A value of false specifies descending order. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。true 为升序，false 为降序。默认为 false
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始。默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size
